audience: Solo founders and owner-operators running the business from one chat surface

bots.why: Routes every request, keeps the 5-item priorities list, hands off to worker Bots without doing work itself
Daily digest: priorities, calendar, spend vs allowance, overnight flags
Workforce oversight: which Bots are idle, stuck, or over budget
Says no safely: declines out-of-scope or irreversible asks with a redirect, never a silent partial
Every material call recorded with options, reasons, and owner so nothing is re-decided
Spend guardrail: watches deploy allowance burn and pages before the cap hits
Human approval gate for anything irreversible: spend, send, delete, publish
Two-pass discipline: a maker drafts, a checker verifies evidence before anything ships
First-hire screen: scores pasted profiles against the role bar with evidence per row, drafts only, never outreach
Keep the fleet small: every proposed Bot defaults to zero until a manual workflow has already worked.
Weekly report of every Bot against its caps; changes nothing.
Morning card: free/busy, next three meetings, one conflict. Never creates events.
Week-1 Bot: diffs installed plugin gitRefs and quotes every move. Installed is not working.

boundary.action: Complete Gmail OAuth and bind only the two declared logical Bots.

proof.semantic_expectation: Both targets show the same bound Gmail account and a declared inbox read returns a real dated message row.

recovery.residue: Disable Gmail on both targets and revoke OAuth; retain account-binding and proof receipts.

boundary.action: Complete Calendar OAuth and bind only the three declared logical Bots.

proof.semantic_expectation: All targets show the bound Calendar account and calendar-owner returns the next three real events without creating one.

recovery.residue: Disable Calendar on all targets and revoke OAuth; retain account-binding and proof receipts.

boundary.action: Complete Drive OAuth and bind only the two declared logical Bots.

proof.semantic_expectation: Both targets show the bound Drive account and one named file metadata read returns its real modified time without editing it.

recovery.residue: Disable Drive on both targets and revoke OAuth; retain account-binding and proof receipts.

boundary.action: Enable the exact repository skill on chief-of-staff and morning-briefing.

proof.semantic_expectation: The digest routes work without performing it and every material row cites its source.

recovery.residue: Disable the skill on both targets; retain source digest and last digest receipt.

boundary.action: Enable the exact repository skill only on workforce-check.

proof.semantic_expectation: The Bot lists idle, stuck, and over-budget logical Bots with one cited observation each.

recovery.residue: Disable the skill; retain source digest and last workforce receipt.

boundary.action: Enable the exact repository skill only on decision-ledger.

proof.semantic_expectation: A material decision reads back with options, reason, owner, and source without an external write.

recovery.residue: Disable the skill; retain the source digest and existing decision rows.

boundary.action: Enable the exact repository skill only on hiring-screen.

proof.semantic_expectation: A pasted profile is scored against the role bar with evidence per row and no outreach.

recovery.residue: Disable the skill; retain only the reviewed screening receipt.

boundary.action: Enable the exact repository skill only on plugin-watch.

proof.semantic_expectation: plugin-watch distinguishes installed, enabled, and working and quotes the returned proof value.

recovery.residue: Disable the skill; retain source digest and last proof result.

boundary.action: On the shared cloud computer, complete browser login for the existing Firecrawl CLI; never install it again or paste a key.

proof.semantic_expectation: firecrawl --status identifies the logged-in account and firecrawl-read returns markdown for the operator-declared URL; an empty MCP census is expected.

approval.boundary: before browser login on the shared cloud computer

recovery.residue: Log out on the shared cloud computer; retain catalog gitRef and the non-secret read receipt.

human_steps: Approve the allowance cap number in allowance-watch config.
Approve the SEND-LOCK policy list and name who may lift a lock.
Review and sign the first decision-ledger entries.
name: Founder Operator
policies: SEND-LOCK-OUTBOUND: nothing leaves the chat (email, post, message) without human approval
SEND-LOCK-SPEND: no purchase, subscription, or paid API call above the allowance without approval
SEND-LOCK-IRREVERSIBLE: no delete, publish, or external share without maker-checker + approval-desk sign-off
EVIDENCE-PER-ROW: every digest row cites its source message or run id

routines.name: morning-briefing
routines.prompt_hint: Summarize priorities, today's calendar, allowance burn, overnight flags; cite sources

routines.name: allowance-watch
routines.prompt_hint: Report spend vs cap, burn rate, top consumers; page if projected to breach

routines.name: workforce-check
routines.prompt_hint: List idle, stuck, and over-budget Bots with recommended action each

approval.scope: operator drops overnight items; a wrong brief is superseded by a corrected one, thread posts remain

oracle.expected: today's date, carried open items with the one thing to do first marked FIRST, overnight news; or exactly 'nothing open' in one line. Short lines, no greeting, no advice, nothing invented

tagline: One chief-of-staff Bot that routes everything and guards your time, money, and decisions
